insights.headline: Gold holds near $4,200 into Wednesday's US CPI; Kazakhstan trims gold share of reserves
insights.summary: Gold probed above $4,200 but could not hold it as traders positioned for Wednesday's US September CPI, the week's deciding catalyst, with ~85% of a December Fed hike priced. Kazakhstan's central bank plans to cut gold from 78% to 75% of reserves by year-end, a notable official-sector pivot. In India, MCX gold eased to Rs 1.51 lakh/10g ahead of Dussehra on a firmer rupee, while silver stayed volatile near Rs 2.26 lakh/kg.

trending.title: US CPI on Wednesday decides gold's next move
trending.summary: Gold is pinned in a $4,100-$4,200 range with supports at $4,052/$4,000 and resistance at $4,225/$4,398; analysts see $4,330 above $4,250 and $4,602 on a confirmed uptrend.

trending.title: Central banks reshape gold demand
trending.summary: Kazakhstan will cut gold to 75% of reserves by year-end, shifting to dollar assets — a rare official-sector reduction signal.

trending.title: Dussehra buying window as MCX gold dips
trending.summary: MCX gold fell to Rs 1.51 lakh and silver to Rs 2.26 lakh ahead of Dussehra; jewellers expect festive demand to pick up through Diwali.

trending.title: Silver leads, then pauses
trending.summary: Silver outperformed into the CPI week with $72 eyed above $65, but Comex settled 0.87% lower at $60.141 on Monday profit-booking.

items.title: Gold fails to sustain a break above $4,200, US CPI in focus
items.summary: FXStreet: gold probed above $4,200 but failed to hold as traders positioned for Wednesday's US September CPI. Supports sit at $4,052 and $4,000; a break of resistance at $4,225 opens $4,398. With ~85% of a December Fed hike priced and the dollar at 18-month highs, CPI is the week's deciding catalyst.

items.title: Kazakhstan central bank to cut gold share of reserves to 75% by year-end
items.summary: PANews: the National Bank of Kazakhstan plans to trim gold from 78% to 75% of its reserves by end-2026, reallocating toward dollar assets. Kazakhstan is among the world's largest official gold holders, so the pivot is a notable central-bank demand signal.

items.title: Gold price outlook: weekly bottom confirmed, two key levels still matter
items.summary: Kitco technical analysis: gold has confirmed a weekly bottom, but daily closes above $4,181.79 and then $4,227.85 are still needed to confirm the uptrend. A sustained break opens $4,602.57; a weekly close below the low would invalidate the setup.

items.title: Gold and silver price forecast: key breakout levels to watch before September CPI
items.summary: FXEmpire: gold targets $4,330 on a break above $4,250, while silver — leading the move — targets $72 above $65. With ~85% of a December Fed hike priced, Wednesday's September CPI (due Oct 14) is the trigger for the next leg.

items.title: Comex silver settles 0.87% lower at $60.141
items.summary: Dow Jones Data Talk via Morningstar: Comex silver settled 0.87% lower at $60.141 on Monday, pulling back from recent highs as traders squared positions ahead of US inflation data.

items.title: Gold, silver prices fall ahead of Dussehra; what festive buyers should know
items.summary: Upstox: MCX gold futures fell 0.41% to Rs 1,51,100 and silver 0.16% to Rs 2,25,770 on Monday as a firmer rupee and profit-booking weighed. 24K gold stood at Rs 1,50,420/10g. Analysts quoted see the pre-Dussehra dip as a window for festive buyers.

items.title: Gold and silver likely to trade range-bound as rupee weakness cushions prices
items.summary: Particle News: MCX December gold holding near Rs 1.51 lakh and Comex December gold around $4,216 are expected to trade range-bound, with rupee softness cushioning domestic prices against global weakness. Key supports and resistances to watch.

items.title: Indian markets pre-market report: bullion steady as USD/INR holds 96.73
items.summary: KarTalks pre-market: spot gold $4,212 (+0.42%), silver $61.25 (+0.70%); MCX gold December Rs 1,51,503 and silver December Rs 2,25,820, with USD/INR at 96.73. Traders eye Wednesday's US CPI for direction.

items.title: Gold prices ease ahead of Dussehra; buyers get relief as rates dip slightly
items.summary: The Orissa Today: gold prices edged lower on Monday, giving Dussehra shoppers slight relief, with 24K gold around Rs 1,50,750/10g in major cities. Festive demand is expected to pick up through the week; silver also softened.

items.title: Silver price today: rates jump 2.17% to Rs 2.40 lakh/kg
items.summary: HDFC Sky: silver rates rose 2.17% to Rs 2.40 lakh/kg on Monday. With Dussehra, Dhanteras and Diwali approaching, jewellers expect more buyers for silver coins, idols and utensils in the coming weeks.
